title: thinner wet-cell film
reason: Landlab's OverlandFlow puts a film of h_init (default 0.001 m) on every cell so its flux formula never divides by zero. On a lake at rest over a bump, the dry crest of the bump carries that 1 mm film and drives a spurious flow that never settles. A 1 µm film keeps the formula well defined and removes the spurious flow; the other tests are not changed by it.
